settings.heading: Gets better with age, elegant and always in style
settings.text: A family leather workshop from Los Baños, Laguna.

settings.heading: Just like a new car, there's nothing like that real leather smell

settings.text: We have always worked in leather. For more than 30 years our family has made wallets, bags and belts by hand, and today we bring that same craft to the tari case. We want sabungeros to own something special and unique, something they can be proud of and pass on to the next generation.

Ricardo has been making products from leather for more than 30 years. In his spare time he raises and trains game fowl. When a farm owner from Bacolod asked whether he could make a tari case from leather, he made one and delivered it personally. It was the beginning of a new market for the workshop.

For years our shop stood at the main gate of the University of the Philippines Los Baños. Students and visiting researchers bought wallets, bags and belts to take home, and some came back years later, now professors, to show us the piece they still carry.

settings.title: Design
settings.text: We sketch your pattern, name or gamefarm logo onto the leather.

settings.title: Tool
settings.text: The design is carved and stamped by hand, then dyed and antiqued.

settings.title: Build
settings.text: Leather is fitted over a fibreglass shell and lined with velvet.

settings.title: Finish
settings.text: Hardware is fitted, edges are finished and the case is checked before it ships.

settings.heading: New builds, first
settings.text: Be the first to see new tari case designs and limited custom pieces.
